scope: Owned loopback native C-Gate 3.4.0 build 2001 and cmqttd against a research-only synthetic method-memory fixture with one unit per programming-method family. Zero-filled memory, UNLOCK challenge 5A and NVM status 00 are fixture choices, not device firmware, persistence or hardware evidence.

no_native_specification.goc: No C-Gate 3.4.0.2001 cbusunits.xml revision names a specification with a goc parameter.

goc2_ack_parameter.native: Accepts a GOC2 selector or STORE acknowledgement only when it names the low address byte (32 <addr&FF> <tag>); with 32 FF <tag> its address selection fails with 408 and it retransmits the STORE three times.
goc2_ack_parameter.cmqttd: Previously required parameter FF; now correlates the low address byte for goc2 and keeps FF for goc/gocbyt.

lazy_over_reads.native: PP LOAD reads nothing; each first GET reads the covering native group, up to the method's recall limit beyond the field (for example 1A 0D 0C for a four-byte tail).
lazy_over_reads.cmqttd: PP LOAD identifies the unit and reads every selected field's exact extent once.

save_verification.native: SAVE_TO_SOURCE sends only the STOREs (plus page, UNLOCK, GIU run flags and NVM commit), with no IDENTIFY, pre-read or readback.
save_verification.cmqttd: Re-identifies type and firmware, pre-reads each changed range and reads it back after its STOREs; the STORE bytes themselves match native.

giu_halt_during_reads.native: Brackets GET reads, as well as SAVE stores, with the FC 03 00 / FC 03 01 run flag.
giu_halt_during_reads.cmqttd: Reads never write; only the STOREs are bracketed by the run flag.

store_tag_scope.native: Numbers STORE tags by group across the whole SAVE (page-0 lock STORE tag 00, page-1 STORE tag 01).
store_tag_scope.cmqttd: Numbers tags within each verified range, so both STOREs use tag 00; every exchange is serialized and correlated by parameter and tag, and each range is read back.

edlt_adjacent_fields.native: Merges adjacent changed fields into one selector and one two-byte STORE.
edlt_adjacent_fields.cmqttd: Stores and verifies each changed field range separately; final memory is identical.

ncc_nvm_gating.native: Every SAVE_TO_SOURCE to a C-Bus 3 unit ends with E3 81 00 04, including a SAVE with no SET and one whose SET repeats the current value; a same-value SET is also stored.
ncc_nvm_gating.cmqttd: Stores only changed bytes and sends the Save-to-NVM EXECUTE only after a changed ncc range was verified, so an unchanged SAVE sends no mutation.

local_checksums.native: Sent every request without a C-Bus checksum on this simulated CNI, whose interface options native C-Gate did not reprogram; this is interface configuration, not a PP method rule.
local_checksums.cmqttd: Checksums local STORE, RECALL, IDENTIFY and OEM frames and leaves 1B, 39, 11 and E3 unchecksummed, as documented.

fixture.memory: zero-filled 64 KiB standard/paged, OEM and GOC images per unit

goc2_parameter_ff_ack_probe.finding: Native address selection fails without a low-address-byte acknowledgement; its GOC STORE path checks only for a negative acknowledgement, retransmits the uncorrelated STORE and still reports SAVE success.
